technique_name: Identify three techniques for developing web applications.
description: Three techniques for developing web applications include Model-View-Controller (MVC) architecture, client-side scripting, and server-side scripting. MVC is a pattern that breaks an application into three distinct parts, namely the model (data structure), view (visual representation), and controller (manages interactions between the model and view).
